channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $65.06 per troy ounce, down 0.99% from the $65.71 it cost on Thursday.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Fails ahead of 0.8100/YTD peak; bullish potential intact
item.description: The USD/CHF pair builds on this week's solid rebound from the 0.7900 mark and gains strong follow-through positive traction for the third consecutive day on Friday.

item.title: British Pound: Trendline break points to deeper losses – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts, led by Kenneth Broux, report that GBP/USD has broken below its ascending trendline from April 2025 and is extending declines toward the March low.

item.title: Global rates: Converging at slightly restrictive levels – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Global Daily stresses that unchanged rates in the UK and US contrast with recent hikes by the ECB and Bank of Japan, but argues this is less divergence than it appears.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Breakout fuelled by hawkish Fed repricing – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux highlights that the Dollar is in breakout territory after DXY moved above 101.00, supported by a hawkish shift in Fed expectations.

item.title: Oil: Strait of Hormuz risks ease but fees loom – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank highlights that a 60‑day US–Iran memorandum of understanding has reduced immediate risks to the global economy by keeping the Strait of Hormuz open, though ship crossings remain limited.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Bears eye YTD low at 0.5680 amid US Dollar’s strength
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) is showing the worst performance among major currencies on Friday, extending its decline against the US Dollar (USD) to 0.5724 lows so far, with the year-to-date low of 0.5781 coming closer.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Uptrend intact as 162 resistance nears – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Kenneth Broux notes that USD/JPY has resumed its advance after holding a multi‑month trendline near 157.40 and breaking out of consolidation. The pair is approaching the 2024 peak around 162, with key support at 159.65/159.10.

item.title: Gold rebounds from one-week low; upside seems limited amid hawkish Fed, bullish USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers slightly from over a one-week low, touched earlier this Friday, though the upside potential seems limited in the face of a bearish fundamental backdrop.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Seems vulnerable near 0.7000; acceptance below 61.8% Fibo. awaited
item.description: The AUD/USD pair recovers a few pips from over a one-week low, touched earlier this Friday, though it lacks follow-through and currently trades around the 0.7000 psychological mark.

item.title: Forex Today: US-Iran talks called off, US Dollar extends rally to 13-month high
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Friday, June 19:

item.title: Indian Rupee weakens ahead of FX Reserves data
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) declines on Friday after registering modest gains against the US Dollar (USD) in the previous day. The USD/INR pair gains ground as the US Dollar rises on traders pricing in the hawkish sentiment surrounding the Federal Reserve (Fed) policy outlook.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds losses near $64.50 as US-Iran peace optimism fades
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) loses ground for the third successive day, trading around $64.70 per troy ounce during the European hours on Friday. Silver price remains under pressure as persistent concerns over inflation and high interest rates are revived by mounting oil supply anxieties.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Consolidating above 161.00 amid growing intervention risks
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains offered against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, and the USD/JPY pair stands comfortably around 161.30, its highest level since 2024, way beyond the level that triggered an alleged intervention on April 30.

item.title: British Pound bounces off one-month low vs JPY on upbeat data; not out of the woods yet
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross attracts sellers for the third straight day on Friday, though it finds some support ahead of a one-month low set the previous day following the release of the upbeat UK data.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Hits 14-month highs above 1.4150 as bullish bias prevails
item.description: USD/CAD holds ground for the seventh consecutive day, trading around 1.4140 during the European hours on Friday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is moving upwards within the ascending channel pattern, signaling a persistent bullish bias.

item.title: Euro: Dollar strength weighs on pair – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank reports that the Dollar Index rose 0.65% to 100.98, while EUR/USD slipped to 1.144. The move comes as US Treasuries partially retraced prior Fed‑driven losses, with the 10‑year yield down 3.4 bps and jobless claims slightly above expectations.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Edges lower below 184.50 on intervention fears, bearish momentum persists
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross loses traction to near 184.45 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges higher against the Euro (EUR) amid fears of currency intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: 1.2%: British Pound remains subdued after UK Retail Sales beat forecasts
item.description: GBP/USD remains subdued for the third successive day, trading around 1.3190 during the early European hours on Friday. The British Pound (GBP) pares its daily losses against the US Dollar (USD) but remains in negative territory following the release of key economic data from the United Kingdom (UK).

item.title: Euro trims losses against British Pound despite bright UK Retail Sales data
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trimming some losses against the British Pound (GBP) on Friday, with the EUR/GBP pair trading at 0.8670 after bouncing from session lows near 0.8660.

item.title: ECB’s Wunsch says central bank may cut rates when the dynamics turn
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker and the head of Belgium's central bank, Pierre Wunsch, said on Friday that the central bank may cut the interest rates when the dynamics turn.

item.title: Oil: Flow resumption tempers war premium – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank reports that Brent Oil initially fell after the US‑Iran memorandum of understanding, as investors faded war‑related economic fears, before reversing to close slightly higher near $79.85.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention risks rise near 1986 lows – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid highlights that the Japanese Yen is trading near its weakest levels since 1986, with USD/JPY around 161.38 after touching 161.80 in late US trading.

item.title: United Kingdom Retail Sales beat expectations in May: What 1.2% means for the British Pound
item.description: Retail Sales, a key measure of consumer spending, in the United Kingdom (UK) climbed 1.2% month-over-month (MoM) in May after falling by a revised 1.0% in April, the latest data published by the Office for National Statistics (ONS) showed on Friday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah inches higher despite MSCI’s concerns regarding investability
item.description: USD/IDR depreciates after three days of consecutive gains, trading around 17,840 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Weakens below 1.1450 amid oversold RSI momentum
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.1425 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The uncertainty surrounding the US-Iran peace deal provides some support to a safe-haven currency such as the US Dollar (USD) and acts as a headwind for the major pair.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Trades above $75.50 on Iran uncertainty; 200-day SMA holds the key
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on the overnight bounce from the $72.80 region, or the lowest level since early March, and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as traders ‌ramp up US rate hike bets, Vance canceled trip to talks with Iran
item.description: The USD/CHF pair advances to around 0.8075, the highest since December 10, 2025, during the early European session on Friday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Swiss Foreign Ministry says US-Iran talks will not take place as planned on Friday
item.description: Swiss Foreign Ministry announced that US-Iran talks at Bürgenstock will not take place as planned on Friday, Reuters reported on Friday.
